contract_term.value: The contract has two parts: implementation of the ERP and licensing. The licensing and support agreement term is five years, with an option in favour of Cowichan Tribes to extend the agreement on the same terms and conditions.
contract_term.quote: The contract will involve two parts.  The first part will be for the implementation of the ERP and the second part will be for the licensing.  The term of the licensing and support agreement is to be for a period of five years, with an option in favour of Cowichan Tribes to extend the agreement on the same terms and conditions.

scope_of_deliverables.value: Cowichan Tribes is procuring a cloud-based ERP system(s) to enhance operational efficiency across finance, procurement, human resources, payroll, and asset management, replacing only the TIFIS functionality identified in the ERP requirements (not all TIFIS capabilities). The deliverables include a signed submission form, narrative response, pricing sheet, and requirements responses, with the narrative organized into sections covering executive summary, proponent overview, and functional areas such as finance.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: Cowichan Tribes is seeking to procure a cloud-based ERP system(s) to enhance operational efficiency across key functions including finance, procurement, human resources, payroll, and asset management. The solution should be aligned with industry best practice, provide features to automate processes, provide staff and leadership access to the information needed to effectively plan and operate, and be adaptable to evolving business needs.

C. MANDATORY SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS 
Each Proposal must also consist of the following components: 
1. The Proposal must be received by the Submission Deadline indicated in 1.4 RFP Timetable and must be submitted using the submission method set out in 1.5 Submission of Proposals. 
2. The Proposal must be in English. 
3. A completed Submission Form in PDF format which is signed by an authorized representative of the proponent described in Appendix C. 
4. A completed Narrative Response in PDF format which follows the table contents in Appendix B – Section A. 
5. A completed Pricing Excel Workbook described in Appendix B – Section G. Template for workbook provided. 
6. A completed Requirements Excel Workbook. Instructions are in the provided requirements workbook.

mandatory_technical_requirements.quote:
D. MANDATORY TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS 
The following sets out the mandatory technical requirements of the proponent and the proposed solution: 
1. Support for organizations operating in Canada including support for Canadian taxes and Canadian Payroll. 
2. Vendor has experience implementing solutions for First Nations in Canada. 
3. The solution must be hosted in Canada and stores all data within Canada. 
4. Implementation vendor(s) can demonstrate they have at least five years' experience implementing Finance, HR, Payroll, and Asset Management solutions. 
5. Solution is cloud based. 
6. The solutions are SOC2 Type 2 compliant or equivalent. 
Failure to meet the mandatory technical will result in disqualification from consideration.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing scored with formula (price threshold ÷ proponent's price) × weighting = proponent's pricing points; Pricing worth 15 of 100 total points (weighting 15, threshold 10.5 = 70%); Pricing submitted via Pricing Excel Workbook (Attachment 2 / Pricing Sheet) covering implementation and support over a 5-year period; rates in Canadian funds inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes, all-inclusive (labour, material, travel, insurance, delivery, installation, overhead, fees by law); resource rates also requested for additional scope; threshold not published but based on projected costs/budget for 5-year implementation, licensing, support.
pricing_structure.quote:
Pricing is worth 15 points of the total score. 
Pricing will be scored based on a pricing formula using the rates set out in the Proponent's submitted Pricing Sheet (Attachment 2). Each proponent will receive a percentage of the total possible points allocated to price, which will be calculated in accordance with the following formula: 
(𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑐𝑒 𝑡ℎ𝑟𝑒𝑠ℎ𝑜𝑙𝑑÷ 𝑝𝑟𝑜𝑝𝑜𝑛𝑒𝑛𝑡ᇱ𝑠 𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑐𝑒) × 𝑤𝑒𝑖𝑔ℎ𝑡𝑖𝑛𝑔= 𝑝𝑟𝑜𝑝𝑜𝑛𝑒𝑛𝑡ᇱ𝑠 𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑐𝑖𝑛𝑔 𝑝𝑜𝑖𝑛𝑡𝑠 
Note on Threshold: Cowichan Tribes will not be publishing the price threshold that will be used in this calculation.  However, the threshold will be based upon the projected costs and budget available for the implementation, licensing, and support of their ERP for the next five years. 
Instructions on How to Provide Pricing 
(a) 
Proponents should submit their pricing information by completing the attached Pricing Sheet and including it in their proposals.  This includes details for implementing and 
supporting the solution over a 5-year period. 
(b) 
Rates must be provided in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes. 
(c) 
Unless otherwise indicated in the requested pricing information, rates quoted by the proponent must be all-inclusive and must include all labour and material costs, all travel 
and carriage costs, all insurance costs, all costs of delivery, all costs of installation and 
set-up, including any pre-delivery inspection charges, and all other overhead, including 
any fees or other charges required by law.
